svg.title: How a chat request reaches the model and the session log
svg.desc: Four pure-ASGI middlewares run outermost to innermost — request id, security headers, body limit, rate limit, auth — so every response including a 413 or a 401 carries a correlation id, an oversized body is rejected before any other work, and a request that will fail authentication is still counted against the rate limit. The route then resolves the manifest, applies inbound screening to the user's messages, and branches on spec.execution.mode: a durable manifest enqueues a fiber and returns 202 with a resume token, while a transient one compiles the agent and runs the turn inline. Either way the turn appends to the Postgres session event log.
